name: Database Disk Space Critical
description: Disk space alert fired for project-db. Disk usage at 92% and growing at ~2GB/hour due to WAL log accumulation from a stale replication slot.

root_cause.summary: Stale replication slot 'project_replica_slot' is preventing WAL cleanup. The replica was decommissioned 3 days ago but the replication slot was never dropped. WAL segments are accumulating at ~2GB/hour.
root_cause.mechanism: PostgreSQL retains WAL segments for active replication slots. When a slot is active but the subscriber is gone, WAL accumulates indefinitely. The slot 'project_replica_slot' is inactive (active=false) but not dropped.
root_cause.trigger: The replica was removed during maintenance 3 days ago (2024-01-17) but the DBA forgot to drop the replication slot.

red_herring.description: A schema migration (adding an index) was deployed to project-service yesterday (2024-01-19). The migration completed successfully and created temp files that briefly spiked disk usage, but those were cleaned up. The ongoing growth is from WAL, not from the migration.

args.message: project-db disk at 92% and growing ~2GB/hr. Stale replication slot 'project_replica_slot' preventing WAL cleanup. Needs DBA to drop the slot.

args.title: project-db disk critical — stale replication slot preventing WAL cleanup
